expected.finding: **[P2]** The new line-reference regex has quadratic runtime on malformed suffixes. At [scripts/revise-improvement-policy.py:307](/home/runner/work/open-inspect-72e95a/open-inspect-72e95a/scripts/revise-improvement-policy.py:307), `tokenize(":1" * n + "x")` retries the remaining suffix at every colon because the final `x` prevents a match. Measured runtimes were 0.031s, 0.121s, 0.483s, and 1.965s for 1,000–8,000 repetitions. Long archived findings can therefore stall policy revision despite the intended linear behavior. Parse the suffix with a linear scan and add a regression case containing repeated colon-number groups followed by a nonmatching character.
